subject: af-td
title: AF.TD.------TH.AF.ALGN.
description: Diagram in PCC-24. (C)AFTD (affinity tendencies) is crossed with TH-AF-ALGN (thrust affinity alignment). Note the (n) prefix on PRI-INFO (primary information) — the (n) prefix in Braxton's CODE notation marks a *negative* or 'not' relation, meaning this is *negative primary information* (primary information functioning by what it is *not*). AFTD → (N)PRI-INFO → TH-AF-ALGN (the crossing) and (N)PRI-INFO → INDIV-DY-RT (individual dynamic reality). INDIV-DY-RT branches three ways: → COS-P (cosmic particulars) → (R)PART (the reality of participation), → CULT-INFO-F (culture information focus) → DYM-F (dynamic functionalism). AFL (affinity alignment) → INDIV-DY-RT in parallel. AFTD → (R)ATTN (the reality of attraction) directly. Structural argument: affinity tendencies reach thrust affinity alignment through negative primary information — i.e., what the primary information is *not* — meaning Braxton's claim is that thrust alignment is constituted as much by exclusion as by inclusion. Individual dynamic reality is the central hub, fed by both negative-primary-information and affinity alignment, and fanning into cosmic particulars (→ real participation), culture information focus (→ dynamic functionalism). The reality of attraction is a sibling output of affinity tendencies, parallel to the thrust-affinity-alignment chain. The (n) prefix is doing key conceptual work: thrust affinity alignment is what *cannot* be the primary information, structurally locating alignment as the residue after the primary information is taken away.
